validation.summary: 13 tests passed, including timeout after SUBMITTING reservation, SUBMISSION_UNCONFIRMED reconciliation, no blind retry, dry run, intervention, and the new worker-check wiring regression.

validation.summary: 719 tests ran; 717 passed, one optional PostgreSQL test skipped, and one unrelated ApplicationPipelineBrowserTests.test_lost_status_and_note_responses_can_be_retried_after_edits teardown assertion failed because its Uvicorn thread remained alive. That test passed in isolation; all 37 browser tests passed in a standalone run.
The unrelated application-pipeline test passed alone in 6.305 seconds.

observed_first_full_run.summary: The first clean-worktree full run showed browser Not Found failures because apps/web/dist is ignored and absent in a new worktree; it also exposed that passing the operation check made a receipt lookup propagate OperationTimedOut after the submit reservation, leaving state SUBMITTING. After building the web bundle and correcting receipt reconciliation, the affected 13-test mock ATS suite passed and the subsequent full run had only the unrelated teardown flake.

observed_baseline_flake.summary: Its 250 ms synthetic remaining budget made Chromium launch fail once in a clean worktree; unchanged immediate rerun passed. No production timeout was weakened.

requirement_limitations: This slice covers the controlled local mock ATS questionnaire and receipt HTTP reads only. Other operation categories and unavailable AI-provider/real ATS paths remain unverified.
Operation cancellation before definitive receipt lookup after a submit reservation preserves SUBMISSION_UNCONFIRMED; no automatic application retry is introduced.
The full suite had one unrelated server-thread teardown flake that passed alone; full-suite result remains PARTIAL for this checkpoint.
